actionType.description: Which form to render: executeAward, recordDebriefRequests, deliverDebriefings, followUpQuestions, protestWindow, agencyPosition, recordDecision, reviewDeliverable, certifyFunds, optionDecision

solicitationId.description: Solicitation number; key into Data Fabric

awardDraft.description: Contract award summary drafted by the robot (JSON)

noticesDraft.description: Notices drafted for the awardee and each unsuccessful offeror (JSON)

debriefDrafts.description: Debriefings drafted per requesting offeror, with disclosure checks (JSON)

followUpDrafts.description: Drafted answers to DoD follow-up questions (JSON)

protestAnalysis.description: Protest grounds mapped to the record (JSON)

scheduleId.description: The schedule row a task is about, such as a deliverable to review or an option to decide (SSSchedule.ScheduleId)

reviewDraft.description: The reviewer agent's check of a deliverable against the contract's requirements, held to the report by the robot (JSON)

packageDraft.description: The option package the robot prepared: the proposal, every check before exercising with its source, and the writer agent's recommendation (JSON)

decision.description: The outcome the person chose (e.g. Signed, Protest filed, Defend, Certified, Exercised, Notice sent, Not exercised)

payload.description: The form's result (JSON or document text)
